intro.lead: Cry monitor listens through this device's microphone. When it hears crying for a while, it starts a crying spell in {{name}}'s log.

how.device: Use a spare phone or tablet in the baby's room.
how.power: Keep it plugged in, with the screen on and this page open.
how.stop: Press Stop when you are done. Leaving this page also stops it.

privacy.onlyOpen: The microphone listens only while this page is open and listening.
privacy.onDevice: Sounds are analysed on this device. They are never recorded, stored or sent anywhere.
privacy.saved: Only the fact that crying was heard is saved: a crying spell with its start and end times.

limits.notSafety: This is not a baby monitor and not a safety device.
limits.miss: It can miss crying, for example from another room or over loud noise. Other sounds can set it off.
limits.beta: It is in testing: it was only checked with recorded sounds, not yet in real homes.
limits.rely: Never rely on it. Always keep a way to hear your baby yourself.

intro.consentGiven: You agreed on this device on {{date}}.
intro.notifications: Get a notification on your other devices when crying is detected

consent.title: Before you start

points.microphone: While the monitor runs, the microphone of this device listens. Sounds are analysed here and discarded at once: nothing is recorded, stored or sent.
points.saved: Only the crying spells it detects are saved to {{name}}'s log, with their start and end times, marked as detected automatically. Family members who turned on the alert may get a notification.
points.others: The microphone also hears other people in the room. Tell anyone who may be there.
points.limits: It can miss crying or react to other sounds. It does not replace hearing your baby yourself.
points.stop: You can stop it at any time, and withdraw this consent on this page.

consent.allowed: I am allowed to monitor this baby

loading.title: Starting the monitor
loading.body: Loading the sound model and asking for the microphone.

listening.label: Cry monitor
listening.screenOn: The screen stays on while listening.

sensitivityHelp.less: Reacts only to clear crying. It may miss quieter crying.
sensitivityHelp.balanced: Recommended: a balance between missing crying and false alarms.
sensitivityHelp.more: Also reacts to quieter crying. Other sounds may set it off more often.

listening.processing: Sensitivity may be lower on this device: the browser kept its voice processing on.
listening.offline: Offline: detected crying is saved here and syncs later.

wakeLock.generic: This device may turn the screen off, which stops listening. Keep it plugged in and set a longer screen timeout in its settings.
wakeLock.ios: This device may turn the screen off, which stops listening. Keep it plugged in and turn off Auto-Lock in Settings > Display & Brightness. Keeping the screen on from the installed app needs iOS 18.4 or later.
wakeLock.android: This device may turn the screen off, which stops listening. Keep it plugged in and set a longer Screen timeout in Settings > Display.

denied.title: Microphone access is off
denied.body: Cry monitor needs the microphone. Allow it for this site, then press Try again.

chromium.open: Tap the icon at the left of the address bar.
chromium.allow: Open Permissions or Site settings and set Microphone to Allow.

iosSafari.open: Tap the page menu (aA) in the address bar, then Website Settings.
iosSafari.allow: Set Microphone to Allow. Or open Settings > Apps > Safari > Microphone.

firefox.open: Tap the lock icon next to the address.

steps.retry: Come back here and press Try again.

unavailable.title: No microphone available
unavailable.body: The microphone could not be opened. Another app may be using it, or this device has none.

lost.title: Microphone interrupted
lost.body: Listening stopped at {{time}}: a call or another app took the microphone, or its permission changed. Nothing after that was heard.

stalled.title: Listening stopped
stalled.body: The microphone stopped at {{time}}, probably because the screen turned off or another app came to the front. Nothing after that was heard.

model.title: Not available right now
model.body: The cry monitor could not start. Check the connection the first time you use it, then try again later.

unsupported.title: Not supported on this device
unsupported.body: This browser cannot run the cry monitor. It needs a recent browser with microphone access on a secure (https) connection.

answer.detected: Detected by the cry monitor. Was she crying?
answer.question: Was she crying?
answer.answeredYes: Detected by the cry monitor. You said: crying.
answer.answeredNo: Detected by the cry monitor. You said: not crying.
